changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2a, item 14: deleted platform/paths.ts's module-level currentConfig global and setRuntimeConfig()/resetRuntimeConfig()/getRuntimeConfig(). getRuntimeConfig() had zero production callers; the five setRuntimeConfig(...) call sites (server.ts, cli/doctor.ts, onboard/run.ts x2, daemon/install.ts) wrote a value nothing in production ever read. Internal-only; no persisted or published-API change.
